name: Spaghetti Bolognese
description: Classic mince pasta with hidden veg in the sauce.
method: Heat the oil in a large pan and soften the onion, garlic and carrot for 5 minutes.
Turn the heat up, add the mince and brown it all over, breaking it up as it cooks.
Stir in the tomato puree, chopped tomatoes, stock and oregano.
Simmer uncovered for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until rich and thickened.
Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water according to the pack.
Season the sauce to taste and serve over the drained spaghetti.

name: Fish Fingers & Chips
description: Oven-baked fish fingers with chunky chips and peas.
method: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the chips in half the oil and spread on a tray.
Cut the cod into finger-sized strips.
Set up three dishes: flour, beaten egg, breadcrumbs. Coat each strip flour, then egg, then breadcrumbs.
Put the chips in the oven and roast for 25 minutes, turning halfway.
Lay the fish fingers on a tray with the remaining oil and bake for the last 12 minutes.
Boil the peas for 3 minutes and serve everything together.

name: Chicken Fajitas
description: Build-your-own wraps with peppers, chicken and toppings.
method: Toss the sliced chicken and vegetables with the fajita spice mix.
Heat a large frying pan or wok until hot.
Fry the chicken and veg for 8-10 minutes, stirring often, until the chicken is cooked and the veg is charred at the edges.
Squeeze over the lime juice.
Warm the tortillas and bring everything to the table for everyone to build their own wraps.

name: Mac & Cheese
description: Creamy baked macaroni with a crunchy breadcrumb top.
method: Cook the macaroni in salted boiling water until just al dente, then drain.
Melt the butter in a saucepan, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute to make a roux.
Gradually whisk in the milk, then simmer gently until thickened.
Take off the heat and stir in most of the cheese and the mustard until melted.
Combine the sauce with the macaroni and tip into a baking dish.
Scatter the remaining cheese and breadcrumbs on top and grill until golden and bubbling.

name: Pizza Night
description: Homemade pizza with everyone picking their own toppings.
method: Heat the oven as high as it will go, with a tray inside to heat up.
Roll each dough ball out into a thin round on a floured surface.
Spread passata over each base, leaving a border for the crust.
Scatter over the mozzarella and vegetable toppings, then drizzle with oil and oregano.
Slide onto the hot tray and bake for 10-12 minutes until the crust is golden and cheese bubbling.

name: Chicken Nuggets & Veg
description: Homemade chicken nuggets with roasted veg sticks.
method: Heat the oven to 200C.
Coat the chicken chunks in flour, then beaten egg, then breadcrumbs.
Lay on an oiled tray and bake for 18-20 minutes, turning halfway, until golden and cooked through.
Toss the broccoli and carrot sticks with the oil and roast alongside for the last 15 minutes.
Serve the nuggets with the roasted veg.

name: Jacket Potatoes
description: Loaded jacket potatoes with beans, cheese or tuna.
method: Heat the oven to 200C. Prick the potatoes all over with a fork.
Bake directly on the shelf for about an hour, until the skins are crisp and the middles soft.
Warm the baked beans in a small pan.
Split the potatoes open and fluff the insides with a fork.
Load with whichever toppings each person fancies: beans, cheese, tuna or butter.

name: Mild Chicken Curry
description: Gentle korma-style curry with rice and naan.
method: Fry the onion, garlic and ginger in a large pan until soft.
Stir in the curry powder and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the chicken and brown on all sides.
Pour in the coconut milk, bring to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes until the chicken is tender.
Meanwhile cook the rice according to the pack.
Serve the curry over rice with warm naan on the side.

name: Toad in the Hole
description: Sausages in crispy Yorkshire pudding batter with gravy.
method: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk to a smooth batter and rest for 20 minutes.
Heat the oven to 220C. Put the oil and sausages into a roasting tin and heat in the oven for 10 minutes until sizzling.
Quickly pour the batter around the sausages and return to the oven immediately.
Bake for 25-30 minutes without opening the door, until well risen and golden.
Warm the gravy and serve straight from the tin.

name: Shepherd's Pie
description: Lamb mince with veg topped with creamy mashed potato.
method: Brown the mince with the onion and carrot in a large pan.
Stir in the stock and tomato puree, then simmer for 20 minutes. Add the peas for the last 5 minutes.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender, then drain and mash with the butter and milk.
Spoon the mince into a baking dish and top with the mash, forking the surface.
Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until the top is golden.

name: Stir-Fry Noodles
description: Quick veggie and protein stir-fry with egg noodles.
method: Cook the noodles according to the pack, then drain and set aside.
Heat a wok until smoking and stir-fry the chicken until cooked through, then remove.
Add the vegetables, garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Return the chicken to the wok, add the noodles, soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss everything together over high heat for 2 minutes and serve immediately.

name: Salmon & New Potatoes
description: Pan-fried salmon with boiled new potatoes and greens.
method: Boil the new potatoes in salted water for 15-18 minutes until tender.
Pat the salmon dry and season. Heat the oil in a pan and fry skin-side down for 4 minutes.
Flip and cook for a further 2-3 minutes until just cooked through.
Steam the green beans for the last 4 minutes.
Squeeze lemon over the salmon and scatter with dill, then plate with the potatoes and beans.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Grilled chicken on romaine with parmesan and croutons.
method: Rub the chicken with oil and seasoning, then grill or pan-fry for 6-7 minutes each side until cooked through.
Rest for a few minutes, then slice.
Tear the romaine into a large bowl and toss with the dressing.
Top with the sliced chicken, croutons and shaved parmesan.

name: Veggie Chilli
description: Bean and lentil chilli with rice and avocado.
method: Soften the onion and peppers in a large pan for 5 minutes.
Add the chilli powder and cumin and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomatoes and beans, bring to a simmer and cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Meanwhile cook the rice according to the pack.
Serve the chilli over rice, topped with avocado if using.

name: Grilled Chicken & Rice
description: Herb-marinated chicken thighs with fluffy rice and salad.
method: Marinate the chicken thighs in the herbs, lemon juice and oil for at least 15 minutes.
Cook the rice according to the pack.
Grill or pan-fry the chicken for 8-10 minutes each side until cooked through and charred.
Rest the chicken for a few minutes, then serve with the rice and cucumber salad.

name: Lentil Soup
description: Hearty red lentil soup with crusty bread.
method: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in a large pot for 5 minutes.
Stir in the cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock, bring to a simmer.
Cook for 25 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are soft.
Blend partially with a stick blender for a thicker texture if you like, then serve with crusty bread.

name: Bean Burritos
description: Spiced black beans with rice, salsa and cheese in wraps.
method: Cook the rice according to the pack.
Warm the beans in a pan with the cumin, mashing some slightly.
Cook the sweetcorn according to the pack.
Lay out the wraps and fill with rice, beans, sweetcorn, cheese and salsa.
Fold and roll tightly, then serve, or grill briefly on each side to crisp the outside.

name: Mediterranean Couscous
description: Fluffy couscous with roasted veg, feta and olives.
method: Heat the oven to 200C. Chop the courgette, peppers and red onion into chunks.
Toss the vegetables with half the oil and roast for 25 minutes until tender and caught at the edges.
Put the couscous in a bowl, cover with boiling water or stock and cover for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Combine the couscous with the roasted vegetables, feta and olives.
Dress with the remaining oil and a squeeze of lemon.

name: Porridge with Fruit
description: Warm oat porridge with banana, berries and honey.
method: Put the oats and milk in a pan and bring to a gentle simmer, stirring often.
Cook for 5-8 minutes until thick and creamy.
Spoon into bowls and top with sliced banana and berries.
Finish with a drizzle of honey and a pinch of nutmeg if you like.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
description: Fluffy scrambled eggs on buttery toast.
method: Whisk the eggs with the milk if using, and a pinch of salt.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over low heat.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently and slowly until softly set.
Meanwhile toast the bread.
Pile the eggs onto the toast and scatter with chives.

name: Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes with maple syrup and fresh berries.
method: Whisk the flour, eggs and milk together until you have a smooth batter.
Rest the batter for 10 minutes.
Melt a little butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Fry spoonfuls of batter for 2 minutes until bubbles appear, then flip and cook for 1-2 minutes more.
Stack the pancakes and top with maple syrup and berries.

name: Smoothie Bowls
description: Blended fruit bowls with granola and seed toppings.

ingredients.name: granola
ingredients.note: use a gluten-free granola if needed

method: Blend the frozen berries, banana and oat milk until thick and smooth.
Pour into bowls.
Top with granola and chia seeds.

name: Full English
description: Bacon, eggs, sausage, beans, toast and tomatoes.
method: Grill the sausages and bacon until cooked through and crisp.
Fry or grill the halved tomatoes and mushrooms.
Warm the baked beans in a small pan.
Fry the eggs to your liking.
Toast the bread and butter it.
Plate everything together and serve hot.

name: Tomato Soup & Grilled Cheese
description: Classic comfort combo - creamy soup with melty sandwiches.
method: Soften the onion and garlic in a pan for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and stock, bring to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes.
Blend until smooth and season to taste.
Butter the bread and fill with cheese, then grill the sandwiches in a pan until golden and the cheese has melted.
Serve the soup with the sandwiches cut into triangles.

name: Wraps & Hummus
description: Veggie wraps with homemade hummus and crudites.
method: Cut the cucumber, carrot and pepper into sticks.
Spread a generous layer of hummus over each wrap.
Layer the lettuce and vegetable sticks on top.
Roll up tightly and slice in half to serve.

name: Tuna Pasta Salad
description: Cold pasta salad with tuna, sweetcorn and mayo.
method: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain and rinse under cold water.
Flake the tuna into a large bowl.
Add the cooled pasta, sweetcorn, cherry tomatoes and spring onion.
Stir through the mayonnaise until everything is coated.
Chill for 20 minutes before serving if you have time.

name: Quesadillas
description: Cheese and bean quesadillas with dipping salsa.
method: Scatter cheese, beans, sweetcorn and spring onion over one half of each wrap.
Fold the other half over to close.
Cook in a dry pan over medium heat for 2-3 minutes each side, pressing down, until golden and the cheese has melted.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Sunday Roast Chicken
description: Roast chicken with all the trimmings and gravy.
method: Heat the oven to 190C. Rub the chicken with butter and herbs and season well.
Roast for about 1 hour 20 minutes, until the juices run clear.
Parboil the potatoes and parsnips for 5 minutes, then roast in a hot tin alongside the chicken for the last 45 minutes.
Boil the carrots until tender.
Rest the chicken for 15 minutes, then make gravy in the roasting tin with the flour and stock over heat.
Carve the chicken and serve with all the trimmings and gravy.

name: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
description: Tender beef with root veg in rich gravy, set and forget.
method: Brown the beef in batches in a hot pan, then transfer to the slow cooker.
Add the carrots, celery, onion and potatoes.
Stir in the stock, tomato puree and bay leaves.
Cook on low for 7-8 hours until the beef is meltingly tender.
Season to taste and serve.

name: Homemade Burgers
description: Seasoned beef burgers with all the fixings.
method: Mix the mince, egg, breadcrumbs and seasoning together in a bowl.
Shape into 4 patties.
Grill or barbecue for 4-5 minutes each side until cooked through.
Top with cheese for the last minute of cooking if using, to melt.
Toast the buns and build the burgers with the toppings you like.

name: Fish Pie
description: Creamy fish pie with mash topping and mixed seafood.
method: Poach the cod and haddock gently in the milk for 5 minutes, then lift out and flake, reserving the milk.
Melt the butter in a pan, stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in the reserved milk to make a smooth white sauce.
Boil and mash the potatoes.
Combine the flaked fish, prawns and sauce in a baking dish, top with the mash and cheese.
Bake at 200C for 25 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges.

name: Pasta Bake
description: Cheesy pasta bake with tomato sauce and hidden veg.
method: Cook the pasta until just al dente, a minute or two less than the pack says, then drain.
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the tomatoes and herbs and simmer for 10 minutes.
Combine the pasta and sauce in a baking dish.
Top with the mozzarella.
Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Chicken Satay Skewers
description: Grilled chicken skewers with a rich peanut satay sauce.
method: Cut the chicken into strips and thread onto skewers.
Warm the peanut butter, soy sauce, coconut milk, garlic and brown sugar in a small pan, stirring until smooth.
Spoon a few tablespoons of the sauce over the chicken and marinate for at least 15 minutes.
Grill or griddle the skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until charred and cooked through.
Meanwhile cook the rice according to the pack.
Serve the skewers with rice, the remaining satay sauce and a squeeze of lime.

name: Pesto Pasta with Pine Nuts
description: Fast pesto pasta finished with toasted pine nuts and parmesan.

ingredients.name: pesto
ingredients.note: basil pesto with pine nuts and parmesan

method: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water until al dente, then drain, reserving a splash of the cooking water.
Toss the hot pasta with the pesto and the reserved water to loosen the sauce.
Stir through the halved cherry tomatoes and a drizzle of olive oil.
Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan for 1-2 minutes until golden.
Divide between bowls and scatter with the toasted pine nuts and grated parmesan.
